module.description: main or the 3-digit overlay number, e.g. 017

residue.description: the exact last wgate.py line when not MATCH, else empty

file.description: absolute path of the final source

description.description: 3-8 word noun phrase for the PR table, e.g. 'Battle menu confirm handler'

lever.description: the source transformation that closed the last residue, named concretely; empty if the first natural source matched

lever_bytes.description: the gate's byte difference just before that transformation; 0 when lever is empty

notes.description: anything the coordinator must know: guessed callee signatures, structs duplicating a header, symbol problems
